d:
From mysterious footprints and unexplained sounds to eyewitness accounts from deep within the wilderness, the search for Bigfoot takes the team through some fascinating encounters. As they investigate fresh leads and examine unusual evidence, every new discovery brings another question. Could these be the clues that finally reveal the truth about Bigfoot?
Watch Finding Bigfoot, S2, Episodes 5, 7, 6, 10, 2, 8 & 3 on Discovery Channel India.
